newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V AJAX FACTS AND FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V AJAX FACTS AND FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures for Sunday's Dutch first division league match between Feyenoord and Ajax Amsterdam.

Major honours: European Champions 1970; UEFA Cup winners 1974; World Super Cup winners 1970; Dutch league champions (13) 1924, 1928, 1936, 1938, 1940, 1961, 1962, 1965, 1969, 1971, 1974, 1984, 1993; Dutch Cup Winners (10) 1930, 1935, 1965, 1969, 1980, 1984, 1991, 1992, 1994, 1995.
Record League Goalscorer: Cor van der Gijp, 162.
Most capped player: Ronald Koeman, Netherlands, 78, 1983-95
Most capped player: Ruud Krol, Netherlands, 83, 1969-83.
Feyenoord v Ajax Amsterdam league record:
Played 40 (since start of Dutch professional soccer in 1956)
Last 10 seasons in Rotterdam from 1986-87 (Feyenoord score first) 2-4, 0-5, 2-1, 0-3, 2-0, 0-4, 0-1, 1-2, 1-3, 2-3.
Corresponding match last season: Oct 22, 1995, Feyenoord 2 (Zwijnenberg 2, Larsson 7) Ajax Amsterdam 4 (Bogarde 13, Litmanen 29, Overmars 37, 57), Attendance 50,000

Fascinating facts: Anyone betting on a 0-0 scoreline should note that there has never been a goalless draw between these two sides in Rotterdam. They have, however, shared nine 1-1 draws. Arnold Scholten and Ronald Koeman are among few players who have played for both Ajax and Feyenoord.
